title: Fail-closed error mislabels corrupt slots as deleted when per-key anchor absent
description: Correctness review of bidu fix: dao_persistence.py:999 in the fail-closed path, when per-key anchor is absent (fresh anchor) and slot files are corrupt (not deleted) while a catalog entry exists, the error says 'initialized RX floor was deleted' though the condition is corruption. Behavior correctly fails closed either way; with durable anchor the message is accurate. Fix: distinguish via _any_slot_exists before choosing the message.
